3D Spatial Knowledge Graph.description: 3D network mesh visualizing parent-child organizational hierarchy and secondary links.
subFeatures: Dynamic viewport minimap navigation
Standard 3D canvas rendering with direct-line hierarchy
Sleek floating glassmorphic toolbar at the top-left containing label, layout, and 2D/3D projection toggles
Left-sidebar toggle switcher underneath citations toggle with symmetric 8px spacing
Unconditional RPG and entertainment node dynamic tree hierarchy pruning
Flat top-right 2D minimap navigation control display
Real-time, relative viewport zoom scale metric indicator overlay
Entity-type-coloured pill label borders in 3D spatial and instanced views
Visible parent-child connection lines on 2D minimap with proper SVG coordinate rendering
Mesh Appearance panel drawer featuring controls for Child Gap, Parent Distance, Tension, and a comparative 'BETA GRAPH' toggle for before/after layout comparison
Global fuzzy search input overlay with suggestions dropdown, distance-sorted tier list, and query highlights
Hover actions menu overlay displaying a small dropdown next to the node label in all graph views
Interactive connection builder banner with autocompletion suggestion autocompletion node targets

Oatmeal Premium Theme Layout.description: Premium theme layout wrapping featuring glassmorphism, responsive sidebar layout with resize handles, voice telemetry integration, and GBP regionalisation.
subFeatures: Interactive top header with model selection and usage tracking
Dual-sidebar architecture with resize drag boundaries
Haptic active state feedback and viewport containment reliability
Direct clipboard screenshot and image pasting support into the chat prompt

Topic Discovery & Session Panel.description: Dedicated control panel managing research sessions, document library categorization and AI synthesis triggers.
subFeatures: Auto-generated session chat logs
Topic tag filtering and suggested prompts
Notebook clipboard for pinning references and drive file sync indicator
Conversational search bar with dynamic query matching
Pinned conversation slots displaying at the top of the history stack
Individual session deletion with Lucide visual progress tracking
Bulk conversation deletion with robust double confirmation safeguards

Hierarchical SVG Sunburst Visualisation.description: Interactive concentric nested radial segment chart representing Turner & Townsend knowledge database and cross-branch secondary connections.
subFeatures: Concentric ring layers (depth 0 to 4) representing entity-type hierarchies
Proportional sector angular sweep based on subtree weights
Click-to-zoom interactive drill-down focus pivoting
Hover glassmorphic metadata cards and title path tooltip popups
Flipped rotated text labels ensuring zero upside-down rendering
Curved glowing transverse secondary links bowing elegantly through the core
Concentric-distance sorted Node Tier Listing overlay dropdown and fuzzy search query matching

PDF Research Workspace.description: Split-screen document viewer integrating react-pdf for rendering reference sources side-by-side with chat or mesh graph.
subFeatures: Interactive citations opening specific PDF page targets
Synchronised page transitions with string integer parsing checks
Drag-resizable split-pane partition using the global layout system layout resizer

SharePointPortalView.description: SharePoint Portal View for the Node Information Panel/Drawer with hierarchical navigation menus and child node inheritance.
subFeatures: Toggle control between Standard View and SharePoint Portal View
Dynamic deep-blue hierarchical navigation bar with multi-level dropdowns and flyout menus representing active sub-trees
Parent node title and node type badge indicators alongside page title header banner
Large prominent blue card depicting the node definition summary
Child node text area cards inheriting and displaying descending procedure definitions under Concept nodes

Simplified Demo Portal.description: Simplified dashboard portal accessible via /demo route with node catalog overview and embedded Sunburst structure view.
subFeatures: Path-based route detection for /demo
Streamlined stats dashboard with quick analytics
Direct link to launch/embed Sunburst Canvas
Beta Views navigation dropdown menu providing access to experimental visualizations
Interactive Sankey Flow Chart mapping capability-to-region-to-BOK dependency paths with floating tooltips
Radial Dependency Wheel drawing neon chords between connected organizational and variant nodes
Centrality Analytics scatterplot plotting degree against frequency with side recommendation panels

Port Status Service.description: Server-side port and ngrok tunnel health check endpoint at GET /api/port-status. Probes all local service ports from the Node.js process so the status is accurate whether the frontend is accessed locally or via an ngrok tunnel. Replaces the previous client-side browser-based port probing which failed when accessed remotely.
subFeatures: Vite portStatusPlugin middleware probes ports 6001, 3001, 5173 server-side using Node.js http.get
Ngrok tunnel status checked via localhost:4040/api/tunnels agent API from the server
Relative /api/port-status URL works transparently through the ngrok tunnel proxy
Proxy bypass rules prevent the /api/port-status route from being forwarded to the backend at port 3001
SyncStatus.jsx polls /api/port-status every 5s instead of attempting client-side port probes

HNSW Vector Index Acceleration.description: High-performance in-process Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) vector index graph with live streaming SSE build progress bar, sub-millisecond similarity lookups (~1-2ms), and memory-cached fallback.
subFeatures: In-process C++ binding via hnswlib-node for 768-dimensional embeddings
Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) progress bar streaming file and vector indexing counters
HnswIndexModal interactive acceleration dashboard with telemetry statistics
Automatic fallback to linear vector search when index is invalidated or unbuilt
Boot-time automatic disk loading of hnsw_index.bin and hnsw_meta.json
Automatic background HNSW graph compilation upon sync and document indexing completion

Gemini Voice Lock & Session Persistence.description: Interactive lock toggle button next to the voice selection dropdown preventing accidental changes and persisting choice across browser sessions via localStorage.
subFeatures: Interactive Lock/Unlock icon button next to voice dropdown
Disabled voice menu and dropdown chevron when locked
Persistent localStorage storage under 'gemini-live-voice-locked' and 'gemini-live-voice'
Amber visual indicator badge when voice lock is engaged
30-second silence inactivity auto-close with 'hang on' / 'wait' keep-alive tool extension (extendKeepAlive)
